title: Rating configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.RatingAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

IsEdit.description: Lets the user change the rating; when false it is read-only.

RatingValue.description: Current rating; decimals render a half-filled item.

Size.description: Size modifier appended as the rating-<Size> class (empty for the default size).

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
